meta.title: feat: allow configuring metrics to reduce cardinality
meta.body_summary: Add configurable error label mode and histogram buckets to reduce Prometheus metric cardinality in erpc.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added configurable error label mode and histogram buckets; maintainer requested constants, duplicate removal, and init fix via inline review; merged after agent and maintainer commits.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 689 changed lines across 14 files, this is a medium-sized configuration and metrics refactor by absolute volume. It fits a targeted observability performance PR that merged after two review rounds and a maintainer follow-up fix.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer aramalipoor requested using constants for error label modes, removing duplicate histogram definitions, reducing default bucket count, and ensuring SetHistogramBuckets is called on init.
review_details.performance_claim: Configurable error label mode (compact reduces error label cardinality) and configurable histogram buckets reduce Prometheus time series count.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin implemented configurable metrics with some code quality issues; maintainer provided specific fix requests and also committed a fix for histogram init, indicating that the agent's initial implementation needed human correction.

detection_detail.code_reading: aramalipoor provided inline review comments on constants, duplicate metric definitions, and default bucket count, leading to Devin adding a constants commit and later maintainer fix for init.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics data or cardinality reduction numbers; evidence is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review, Devin added constants commit; maintainer then added a fix commit to set up histograms on init and adjust other files; no regression was introduced outside the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added MetricsConfig fields errorLabelMode and histogramBuckets, implemented compact error label mode in ErrorSummary, added SetHistogramBuckets to replace Prometheus histogram metrics with custom buckets, and wired initialization in Init function. Default bucket list reduced to 4 values. Error label mode uses constants.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files, docker-compose, and documentation changes are for integration; the primary logic is in metrics, errors, and init.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by Devin: added config fields, histogram buckets, error label mode, documentation.
Devin follow-up: use constants for error label modes per review.
Maintainer commit: fix histogram setup on init, reduce default buckets, clean up duplicate definitions; also adjusted integration code.

review_signals.summary: Requested using const variable types instead of strings for compact/verbose error label modes.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin committed change to use constants.

review_signals.summary: Requested removing duplicate histogram variable definitions and calling SetHistogramBuckets on init with default buckets even if no config set.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer later fixed this in a separate commit.

review_signals.summary: Suggested reducing default histogram buckets to only 4 values (0.05, 0.5, 5, 30) instead of many.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer committed a fix that reduced default buckets.
